description: Send a cross-border transfer to a pre-created beneficiary. Supports same-currency payouts (source_currency === transfer_currency) or FX-inclusive payouts. Use quote_id from a prior quote for locked rates.

quote_id.description: Optional FX quote id to lock the rate

reason.description: Payout reason (e.g. GOODS_PURCHASE, SERVICES_FEE, PAYROLL, INVESTMENT) — required by regulators

source_amount.description: Amount debited from wallet in source_currency

transfer_amount.description: Amount credited to beneficiary in transfer_currency

name: create_transfer
